correctedState: Confirmed as written, with two additions worth carrying. (a) The effective production value really is 1, not merely the constant: the only host seed of the orchestrator config (packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:4152-4164) never sets `depth`, so `maxDepth: config.orchestrator?.depth` (packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:1279) resolves to undefined and DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH wins on every session; spawner.test.ts:542-555 proves the grandchild refusal and, as a positive control, that maxDepth 2 admits it. (b) The gap is two-part — the default is 1 against Claude's 3, AND there is no configurable override at all (no CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH reader and no NESSY_ equivalent anywhere in packages/, apps/ or scripts/), so a host can only raise nesting by supplying `orchestrator.depth` in the execution manifest, which no production path does. Note the shape of the deviation: at the limit we return `Subagent depth limit exceeded (N)` from the call, which matches the page's FORK behaviour (:862 'the tool returns an error instead of spawning') but not the named-subagent behaviour (:862/:326 'withholds the Agent tool'); spawner.ts:514-517 records that deviation knowingly. The stale closure at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-r-queue-doc-verification.md:555 and :559 should be reopened.
